milestone.description: Milestone for triaged issues that have not yet been scheduled for resolution.

issue.body:
If an issue meets the following criteria it should be move into the [Backlog milestone](https://github.com/angular/angular/milestone/82):

1. The issue is not assigned to any milestone AND

    1. The issue is of "type: bug" and has the following additional labels:
        - "severity: *"
        - "frequency: *"


    2. OR the issue is of "type: feature".

All the other "type: *" labels and any other labels should be ignored for now, leaving those issues in the current milestone.
